unifieddb.delta: Do not erase A->B->A content chains from projection invalidation solely because fingerprints match. Preserve touched logical identities and impact seeds unless record/version/provenance identity stability is explicitly witnessed.

claygraph.delta: Projection final-state equality must include record/version/provenance-bound access identity, not only content fingerprint equality and global epoch.

runtime/continuity.delta: The previously reported fully-cancelled metadata-only epoch gap may be a symptom of overaggressive content cancellation. Conservatively recomputing touched identities lets existing SPM publish the new epoch without a synthetic logical change.

harness/recovery.delta: Recovery/replay must test content-ABA across crash boundaries and verify that final access segments reference current record identities after raw-event replay.

frank/database-pulse.delta: Database Pulse effectivization remains physical projection maintenance only. Any episode/provenance identity touched by raw events cannot be erased from causal semantics merely because payload content returns to a prior value.
